blurb: Taste all of Chicago’s classic eats on this 4 1/2 hr Adults-only guided food & bicycle tour! Join the expert guides of Bobby’s Bike Hike, America’s first city bike tour company, on this exciting & informative adventure which recently ranked Top 20 Food Tours in the World by TripAdvisor. The journey is a leisurely paced 13mi & includes deep dish pizza, Chicago-style hot dog, Italian Beef, & dessert. Upgrade to sample local craft beer! On the DAY version of bike tour, you’ll drink in the sights of Chicago’s beautiful northside neighborhoods, including the Lakefront and Wrigleyville, home to our Chicago Cubs baseball team. On the NIGHT bike tour, you'll ride through the major downtown attractions & see the lights of Buckingham Fountain, Millennium Park and the glorious skyline. Cruise the Lakefront Trail, one of the most popular waterfront bike paths in the country. Don’t miss out on this fun tour! You’ll leave with a profound understanding of Chicago, even if you only came for the food.
